transcript: Oh, hi! Sorry, I just got back from a weekend trip so I'm still a bit tired, haha. We went to Vung Tau with some friends from university, we try to go every year. Honestly the seafood was amazing, we found this small place near the back beach, they grill the squid right in front of you, and the sauce, the green chilli salt one, I've never had one that good. If you ever go I really recommend it, I can send you the name. We also rented bikes and rode up to the lighthouse in the morning, the view from there is really beautiful, you can see the whole coast. The traffic coming back to the city on Sunday was terrible though, it took us almost four hours. Um, anyway, I'm very excited about this job. I've been following the company for a while and the culture looks really good, everyone seems friendly. I would be a great fit because I'm hard-working and I learn fast, and I really enjoy building things with other people. I hope we can talk more soon. Thank you so much for your time and for considering me.
